# flutter_device_ai

> Flutter plugin for on-device generative AI. Uses the OS-managed model (Apple Foundation Models on iOS/macOS 26+, Gemini Nano via Google AICore on Android, Chrome's built-in Prompt API on web) with a local llama.cpp fallback model (any GGUF, via llamadart) when the device has no OS model. No model is bundled; the OS models need no network, the fallback downloads one GGUF once. No API key.

Import: `import 'package:flutter_device_ai/flutter_device_ai.dart';`
Test double: `import 'package:flutter_device_ai/testing.dart';`

## Core calls

```dart
final ai = FlutterDeviceAi();                       // singleton; FlutterDeviceAi.withFallback(fallbackAdapter: ...) for a custom one
final a = await ai.availability();                    // OnDeviceAiAvailability: status, reason (enum), message
await FlutterDeviceAi.ensureReady(onProgress: (p) {}); // download model; on web only from a user gesture
final r = await ai.generateText(prompt: '...');       // AiResponse: text, json, tokenCount, generationTimeMs
await for (final d in ai.generateTextStream(prompt: '...')) {}  // text deltas
final s = await ai.createSession(systemInstruction: '...', tools: [...]);
final reply = await s.ask('...');                     // or addQuery()+getResponse()
await for (final d in s.askStream('...')) {}
await s.stopGeneration();                             // throws OnDeviceAiCancelledException in pending call
await s.close();                                      // always close sessions
```

## Structured output
`GenerationConfig(responseFormat: ResponseFormat.json, schema: {...JSON Schema...})` then `response.json`.
Supported keywords: type, enum, properties, required, additionalProperties:false, items, minItems, maxItems, minLength, maxLength, minimum, maximum, pattern. Others throw `OnDeviceAiSchemaException`. Result is validated; invalid replies are re-asked up to `maxRepairAttempts` (default 2), then `OnDeviceAiStructuredOutputException(errors, rawText)`. Streaming with a schema yields the validated answer as one chunk.

## Tools
`OnDeviceAiTool(name, description, parameters: [ToolParameter(...)] | parameterSchema: {...}, onCall: (Map args) => Map result)`. Pass via `createSession(tools: [...])` (or `registerTools` for one-shot calls). Throw `OnDeviceAiToolException(msg)` to report an error to the model. Native on Apple, emulated (JSON protocol, validated, max `maxToolRounds`) elsewhere. `onCall` must return a JSON-encodable map.

## Capabilities
`await ai.capabilities()` -> backend, streaming, toolCalling/structuredOutput (`CapabilitySupport.native|emulated|unsupported`), imageInput, exactTokenCounts, modelDownload. Branch on this, never on the platform name.

## Fallback
`FlutterDeviceAi.withLocalModel(model: 'hf://owner/repo/file.gguf', contextSize: 4096)` then `await ai.prepare(onProgress: ...)` (downloads once, only when the OS model is unavailable). Default model Qwen2.5 0.5B Instruct Q4_K_M. Any GGUF or `.litertlm` source (`hf://`, `https://`, file path). Needs iOS 16.4+, macOS 14+, Swift Package Manager enabled, INTERNET on Android. Tune it with `FlutterDeviceAi.withFallback(fallbackAdapter: LocalLlmFallbackAdapter(model:, contextSize:, sha256:, idleUnloadAfter:, allowDownload:))`; `adapter.status` (idle|downloading|loading|ready|unloaded), `isDownloaded()`, `deleteModel()`, `unload()`, `cancelPrepare()`, `LocalLlmFallbackAdapter.presets` / `recommendedFor(ramGb)`. Uses the model's chat template; JSON schemas are grammar-constrained. If the OS model fails with unavailable mid-session, the session fails over to the fallback. macOS sandbox needs `com.apple.security.network.client`. Custom engines: `FlutterDeviceAi.withFallback(fallbackAdapter: CallbackFallbackAdapter(onGenerateText: ..., onGenerateStream: ..., isModelReady: ...))` or implement `OnDeviceAiFallbackAdapter`. Adapters are stateless; the package passes `List<FallbackMessage>` to `generateChat` on each turn (default renders "User: ...\nAssistant: ...\nAssistant:" into `generateText`). Used whenever the OS model is not `available`. Windows and Linux always use it.

## Fallback vision
`FlutterDeviceAi.withLocalModel(model: p.source, projector: p.projector)` with `LocalLlmFallbackAdapter.visionPresets` (SmolVLM 500M) enables `session.addImage`; `capabilities().imageInput` reports it. Custom adapters override `supportsImages` and read `FallbackMessage.images`.

## Embeddings / RAG
`final embedder = LocalEmbedder(); await embedder.prepare();` (BGE small GGUF, ~36 MB). `final index = RagIndex(embedder: embedder); await index.addDocument(id, text); await index.search(q, k:, minScore:); await index.contextFor(q); index.asTool()` (give to `createSession(tools:)`). Persist with `index.toJson()` / `RagIndex.fromJson(json, embedder:)`. `InMemoryVectorStore`, `chunkText`, `OnDeviceAiEmbedder` (implement for other engines). Same embedder for index and query. Tests: `FakeOnDeviceAiEmbedder`.

## Speech to text
`final stt = LocalSpeechToText(); await stt.prepare(); await stt.transcribeFile(path)` / `transcribeBytes(bytes)`. Qwen3-ASR via llama.cpp, ~1 GB, clips up to ~30 s.

## Errors (all extend OnDeviceAiException, field `code`)
Unavailable, Unsupported, UserActivationRequired (web), SessionBusy, Cancelled, StructuredOutput, Schema, Generation.

## Generative UI
`OnDeviceUiGenerator().generateModule(goal, language:, principles:, tools:, onText:)` -> `GenUiModuleSpec?` (null + `lastError` on failure). Block types: stat, progress, checklist, list, steps, table, callout, note.

## Pitfalls
- A session runs one turn at a time (`OnDeviceAiSessionBusyException`); open several sessions for parallelism.
- `isAvailable()` is true if the OS model is ready OR a fallback is ready; use `availability()` for the native state only.
- Web: `ensureReady()` must run inside a click/tap handler.
- Android needs minSdk 26 and Google AICore; Apple needs iOS/macOS 26+, Apple Intelligence enabled, Xcode 26+. The plugin itself needs Flutter 3.38+, iOS 16.4+, macOS 14+. On Apple, availability runs one tiny probe generation, so a missing model (simulator on a Mac without Apple Intelligence) reports unavailable and routes to the fallback.
- Image input: Android only (`session.supportsImages`).
- `maxTokens` is ignored by Chrome. On-device models are small: keep prompts short and tool lists small.
- Do not mock the plugin with method-channel stubs; use `FakeOnDeviceAiPlatform`.
